about: fm1-emu commits that passed the upgrade check (.github/workflows/pocket-emu.yml) against the previous pin, and the listening test that followed. Pocket pins its engine in pocket/emu/upstream.json and the Mac app in fm1-pocket-mac's Emu/Cargo.toml, independently; each should only move to a commit listed here. The Mac app's build checks its pin against this list and warns if it is missing.

commits.note: The evaluation baseline (no earlier pin to compare with): every Hub package measured on Linux, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel and the browser engine. Listening test: pending (Dean, MacBook).
